result:
I've planned round 487: it fixes **B-R486-PROFILE-NAME-KEYBOARD**, a Medium bug where the name on `/account` can only be edited with a mouse. The decision is **CONTINUE**. I changed no app code, and `store/` is clean at `bb82154`.

**Round 486 result:** C passed it with real browser evidence and 0 bugs, and root published it as `bb82154`. B-R480-ORDER-CARD-KEYBOARD is now done for the client path. The check against real backend orders stays open because the backend doesn't run in the cloud. The reviewer notes were recorded on existing ids, plus one new Low test-gap id. The regression round isn't due until 2026-11-16.

**What I found on the current code, in Chromium:**
- The name is not reachable with Tab.
- Esc, Cancel and Save all drop focus to `<body>`.
- Holding Enter in the name field sends 6 save requests.
- The two inputs and the ✓/✕ buttons have no accessible names.

**The fix A will apply (sketch v4, `b-round-486/sketch-487.patch.txt`):**
- The name becomes a real button, announced as "Full Name <name>".
- After closing or saving, focus returns to that button; after a failed save it goes to First name. Esc is ignored while a save is running.
- Holding Enter now sends one request (the old code sends two even with an instant save), using the project's shared held-Enter helper.
- The inputs and ✓/✕ buttons get labels.
- Nothing changes visually: 18 screenshot pairs show 0 px difference below the header at 1440, 1280 and 375.

On the sketch, the 14 test mutants all fail, the full suite passed (4,273 tests), and tech-lead approved each version. My first draft failed the full suite, because the repo forbids an inline held-Enter check, so v2 switched to the shared helper.

**Two things recorded along the way:**
- **SABA-B-17-ENTRANCE-3-4S (Medium, round 488):** your 2026-11-13 request that the entrance animation last at least 3–4 s had no backlog entry. Today it lasts 1.45–1.9 s.
- **B-R487-PROFILE-EDITOR-NARROW-OVERFLOW (Medium, round 489):** at 375 px the name editor's ✓/✕ buttons sit off-screen and can't be tapped. This was already so before this change.

**Order:** 487 this fix, then 488 the entrance timing, then 489 the narrow editor, then DPG-BUTTON-CLEANUP. If planning happens on or after 2026-11-16, the regression round goes first.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice. The second call led to v4: I dropped the `select-text` class because a browser test showed it had no effect, and added keyboard rows for a fast save and a failed save.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- current-task.md
- tasks/round-486.md
- b-round-486.md
- b-next.json
- feature-status.md
- backlog.json
